clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he put helmets on a hundred people to measure their brainwaves - the super wealthy against everyone else.

The average person spends their waking hours in beta: what he calls the poverty wave, the slave wave, the stress wave. People with a hundred million dollars or more barely touch it. They run on theta and gamma all day, and far more delta at night.

Reduce the beta wave, he says, and everything else goes up automatically - even your results when you're doing the technique wrong.

Which wave have you been running on today?
